title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $300 on the Eufy C28 robot vacuum and mop
excerpt: Our favorite budget roller mop just got cheaper.
content_html:
SAVE $300: As of Aug. 4, the Eufy C28 robot vacuum and mop has been discounted to $499.99 at Amazon. That's a $300 price cut from its list price of $799.99.

Credit: Eufy

$499.99 at Amazon
$799.99 Save $300

Amazon's a great place to look for solid discounts on robot vacuums, and the retailer has just dropped an excellent deal on one of our favorites: the Eufy C28 robot vacuum and mop. For a limited time, you can snag this combo cleaner for $300 off.

Normally priced at $799.99, the Eufy C28 has been discounted to $499.99 at the retailer as of Aug. 4. That's a huge discount, and we certainly think it's a model well worth investing in.

Mashable Trend Report

Mashable's Leah Stodart considers the Eufy C28 the best budget roller mop in our overall roundup of the best robot vacuums, noting that its "roller mop is targeted toward the cleanup of large liquid spills, easily making the C28 the best budget robot vacuum mop combo for fast-paced homes and in-the-moment cleanup." Stodart's review also adds that it did a "solid job of sopping up a variety of liquid spills, from wine and orange juice to ranch and conditioner that exploded on my bathroom floor."

While its mopping is a real highlight, its 15,000 Pa suction is also very helpful on carpets. Stodart's review mentions that it's "15,000 Pa was potent enough to clear a mess of spilled catnip and crushed potato chips from my tufted living room rug, leaving no visible crumbs behind." Plus, it features LiDAR navigation that helps it avoid obstacles as it cleans.

This offer is only available for a limited time, so be quick to save on the Eufy C28 robot vacuum and mop at Amazon.

可混搭趋势报告

Mashable 的 Leah Stodart 认为 Eufy C28 是我们对最佳机器人真空吸尘器的整体综述中最好的预算滚筒拖把，并指出其“滚筒拖把的目标是清理大量液体溢出物，很容易使 C28 成为适合快节奏家庭和即时清洁的最佳预算机器人真空拖把组合。” 斯托达特的评论还补充说，它“在吸收各种液体溢出方面做得非常出色，从葡萄酒和橙汁到在我浴室地板上爆炸的牧场和护发素。”

虽然它的拖地功能确实是一大亮点，但其 15,000 Pa 的吸力对地毯也很有帮助。 斯托达特的评论提到，“15,000 Pa 的压力足以清除我客厅簇绒地毯上乱七八糟的猫薄荷和碎薯片，不留任何可见的碎屑。” 此外，它还具有激光雷达导航功能，有助于它在清洁时避开障碍物。
